reaction_steps.title: Regioselective SNAr C-O Coupling

reaction_steps.title: Quench, Workup & Crystallization
reaction_steps.reagents: Ice-cold deionized water (250 mL), cold Et2O (60 mL)
reaction_steps.procedure: The reaction mixture is cooled to 22 °C and poured slowly into ice-cold deionized water (250 mL) with vigorous mechanical stirring, inducing immediate precipitation. The white solid is collected by vacuum filtration, washed with cold water (3x 50 mL) and cold diethyl ether (2x 30 mL). The damp filter cake is recrystallized from boiling 95% ethanol/water (4:1 v/v) to give pure white needle crystals.

workup.quench: Poured slowly into 5 volumes of ice-cold deionized water with mechanical agitation
workup.extraction: Vacuum filtration on sintered glass Buchner funnel; solid retained
workup.washing: Ice-cold water (3x 50 mL), cold diethyl ether (2x 30 mL)
workup.drying: Vacuum drying oven at 45 °C over anhydrous P2O5 for 14 hours

green_metrics.safety_precautions: Exotherm control upon aqueous quenching; DMF recycled via vacuum distillation.
